SELECT r.homework_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submitted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS corrected_count, SUM(r.score) AS score_total, COUNT(r.score) AS score_count FROM edu_homework_record r JOIN () a ON a.homework_id = r.homework_id AND a.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.homework_id IN GROUP BY r.homework_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status >= 1 THEN r.student_id END) AS submitted_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN r.student_id END) AS corrected_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = 3 THEN r.student_id END) AS redo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.score >= #{passScore} THEN r.student_id END) AS pass_count, SUM(r.score) AS score_total, COUNT(r.score) AS score_count, MAX(r.score) AS max_score, MIN(r.score) AS min_score FROM (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM edu_homework_assignee WHERE deleted = 0 AND homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND student_id IS NOT NULL) a LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record r ON r.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND r.student_id = a.student_id AND r.deleted = 0
